mentions.name: Home fruit and vegetable garden
mentions.description: A home garden project planting fruit trees, strawberries, and vegetables that is currently watered by hand; the gardener has been thinking about adding automated irrigation.
mentions.source_excerpt: Planted a few fruit trees, some strawberries, and vegetables. Every time I water them, I think about automated irrigation.
